task: Add four procedural fallback landmark builders to src/buildings/extras.js: buildHairSalon, buildVetClinic, buildFlowerShop, buildSushiRestaurant. The registry entries in src/config/landmarks.js already reference these exact export names (X.buildHairSalon, X.buildVetClinic, X.buildFlowerShop, X.buildSushiRestaurant), so the build is currently broken until they exist.
requirements: Signature and conventions identical to the existing small shop builders (buildBakery, buildCafe, buildRestaurant, buildBookstore): `export function buildX({ size, sign, rng })`, returns a THREE.Group, origin on the ground at lot centre, entrance facing local +Z. Use the shared helpers already in the file (addBuildingPlinth, addPitchedRoofFinish, addFaceWindow, addSideWindow, addEntranceApproach, facadeSign, shared PALETTE / mat / glow / box / cylinder / sphere / roundedBox / mesh). Every building must read on all four sides, like the eight vocabulary-first shops (DESIGN_DECISIONS.md / CURRENT_STATE.md 'Toy-town buildings').

All four are sizeClass 'small': footprint envelope is [16, 14]. Clamp body size the way buildBakery does (w = Math.min(size[0]-4, ~10.5), d = Math.min(size[1]-5, ~8)); everything incl. props/awnings must stay inside the envelope.
Each must be identifiable WITHOUT its sign through 2+ signature forms (vocabulary-first). Stylized, cheerful, lightweight, same tone as the bakery/cafe/restaurant.

buildHairSalon: bright clean facade, large glass storefront, a striped red/white/blue barber pole beside the door that spins via g.userData.animate(dt, time) (same animate convention used elsewhere in the file), a scissors or comb motif sculpted on the facade, a mirror/chair silhouette visible through the window if cheap.

buildVetClinic: clean clinic facade (white/mint), a big paw-print motif (pad + four toes) and a small green cross, a simple procedural dog and cat by the entrance (box/sphere figures). Expose g.userData.exciteAnimal = (animal) => {...} where animal is 'dog' | 'cat' | null (null = both): the named animal(s) become lively for ~6s (dog bounces / tail wags, cat hops / tail swishes), driven from g.userData.animate. Mirror how buildZoo/buildFarm implement exciteAnimal + animate (src/systems/activities.js `animals` animation calls model.userData.exciteAnimal(opts.animal) every 4s). Animals idle gently when not excited.

buildFlowerShop: colourful striped awning, outdoor tiered flower display with buckets/planters of multicoloured blooms (spheres) along the front, a window box, greenery; flowers on at least one side too. Keep mesh count modest (reuse geometry/materials, no per-flower unique materials).

buildSushiRestaurant: Japanese restaurant front distinct from the existing ramen buildRestaurant (which already has a red hip roof, noren and lanterns): use e.g. dark timber + white plaster walls, a short noren in indigo/navy, a sculpted nigiri or fish shape on the facade or a sushi-counter vibe visible through a wide window, warm glow lanterns (glow material). Must not look like a recolour of buildRestaurant.
Add the four builders in the 'SHOPS AND FOOD' section (vet near the civic builders is also fine), with a short comment per builder naming its signature cues, matching existing comment style.
Append a short line to the 2026-11-22 entry at the end of DESIGN_DECISIONS.md naming the signature cues chosen for each of the four buildings. Do not edit other entries.
constraints: Edit only src/buildings/extras.js and DESIGN_DECISIONS.md. Do not touch src/config/*, src/systems/*, or other builders.
No new dependencies, no textures/external assets (school networks block downloads); geometry and shared materials only.
No per-frame allocations in animate functions.
Edit source with structured edit tools, not shell/python rewrites; the first quoting/escaping failure ends shell-based editing.
Read DESIGN_DECISIONS.md sections on building footprints / toy-town buildings before editing.

behavioralAcceptance.description: Controller renders each of the four buildings in the live town and judges silhouettes visually.
